subject: Modular package modulation — distributor margin guardrails & private-offer ask
body:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@novalabs.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 26 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer ask — modular SKUs + distributor margin expectations

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this. We are starting procurement conversations for a private offer on GCP (NovaLabs internal). We need a modular packaging option rather than a single committed SKU: 3 base SKUs (inference, reserved nodes, support) and optional add-ons for enterprise features. Key asks:
- A pricing matrix by SKU with stepped discounts at 50k / 150k / 500k monthly spend
- Distributor margin guidance — our distributor will want a minimum floor to carry the deal; they'd like ~20% but we need to understand Redwood constraints
- Any early-adopter credits or implementation rebates you can include (we have an aggressive adoption timeline)

Attached: PRICING_REQ.xlsx (high-level forecast).

Can we get a short proposal before Tue so we can align on commercials for our internal steering committee?

Thanks,
Maria
Procurement Manager
NovaLabs

---

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@novalabs.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 26 Aug 2028 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer ask — modular SKUs + distributor margin expectations

Maria — thanks for the deck and the ask. We're happy to put together a modular private offer. Quick summary of next steps from our side:
1) We will propose a modular pricing table with the 3 base SKUs + add-ons and stepped discounts at the bands you provided.
2) We typically cap distributor/reseller margin at 18% for private offers that include partner-enabled implementation credits; above that we need an explicit approval from our revenue leadership.
3) We can offer an early-adopter implementation credit (one-time) up to 7% of first-year ARR, subject to deal size and commit cadence.

Ben — looping you for margin scenarios and a recommended approval path if NovaLabs insists on a 20% distributor margin.

Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachment: PRICING_REQ.xlsx (xlsx stub)

---

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 27 Aug 2028 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer ask — modular SKUs + distributor margin expectations

Kimberly — draft margin scenarios attached. High-level guidance below:

- Standard band (no extra credits): reseller/distributor net margin up to 15% is straightforward. This preserves list-price economics and keeps onboarding credits minimal.
- Allowed uplift (strategic / high-touch): up to 18% margin if Nova signs a 12–18 month commit and accepts a slightly lower list price on the reserved nodes SKU. Requires distributor evidence (distribution agreement) and a signed reseller addendum.
- Exceptional concession (pre-approved by revenue leadership): up to 20% margin but only if deal size >= $1.2M ARR and we receive an implementation fee contribution from the distributor (to offset CAC). This needs LAURA sign-off and finance acceptance.

I attached margin_scenarios_v2.pdf with a waterfall showing impact to Redwood net ARR at each band and suggested DocuSign redlines for the reseller addendum. Also included a Proforma that maps to the SKU bands from Maria's sheet.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMarginScenarios
Attachment: margin_scenarios_v2.pdf (pdf stub)

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 28 Aug 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer ask — modular SKUs + distributor margin expectations

Forwarded message:
> From: ben_carter@redwood.com
> To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
> Date: Mon, 27 Aug 2028 08:47:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: Private offer ask — modular SKUs + distributor margin expectations
>
> (see attached scenarios)

Team — reviewed the scenarios. Approve the 18% margin band as a maximum for this deal provided the following conditions are met:
- NovaLabs signs a 12-month minimum commit at the 150k band or higher
- Distributor provides a current reseller agreement showing their margin expectations and implementation support (we need evidence)
- All early-adopter credits are amortized over first-year ARR and capped at 7% as Ben outlined

If Nova pushes to 20% we escalate to Revenue Ops + CFO and require a distributor cost-share on implementation.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@novalabs.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Aug 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood private offer — modular packaging proposal and next steps

Hi Maria — good conversation internally; thanks for sending the forecast. Attached is our initial private-offer PDF (Redwood_PrivOffer_Nova_v1.pdf) that maps to your modular SKU ask. Key commercial highlights: 

- Modular structure: Inference (SKU-INF), Reserved nodes (SKU-RSV), Support (SKU-SUP) + add-ons for Enterprise Security and Dedicated Networking.
- Discount bands: 50k = 8% off list; 150k = 14% off list; 500k = 20% off list (applies per-SKU).
- Distributor margin: Redwood will approve up to 18% reseller margin for this private offer, subject to: distributor evidence (signed reseller agreement), NovaLabs signing a 12-month commit at the 150k band (or higher), and amortization of any early-adopter credit over the first year.
- Early-adopter implementation credit: one-time credit up to 6% of first-year ARR (conditional on implementation milestones).

If that fits, I can send the DocuSign for signature this week. Next steps I suggest:
1) Please share the distributor reseller agreement (redacted) by EOD Thu so we can vet margin proof.
2) Confirm which SKUs and approximate monthly quantity for each band so we can lock list price and seat counts.
3) If agreed, I will send the DocuSign link and proposed start-of-service date.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/secure/12345abcdef
Attachment: Redwood_PrivOffer_Nova_v1.pdf (pdf stub)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call to walk through the table.

Best,
